findings.evidence: dom-1440: h2#h-reach, h2#h-empty, the 'Telegram' link and siblings have opacity 0 after load; focus.json still stops on 'Telegram', 'Text the plant', 'Send follow-up', 'Snooze' (sweep: no visible focus on Telegram). Tile 01 shows an empty band where they sit. Visible only with reduced motion or scripts off (hidden.json).
findings.after: Default .reveal to opacity:1; add the hidden start state only inside a class set by JS after IntersectionObserver is attached, and always remove it on focusin
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.7 Focus Visible and 1.3.2: four focusable controls are invisible to sighted keyboard users. Confirms the sweep focus_ring Floor hit.

findings.evidence: Button accessible name is 'Copy' only; out of context it does not say what is copied (the line 'Ask Harbor for the revised PO before Friday.').
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context) applied to the control's name; 2.4.6 Labels.

findings.evidence: focus.json stop 11 is a focusable div (not textarea) containing 'Thanks for the update. Can you send the revised PO by Thursday?'; forms.json is empty, so it is not a form control. The visible label 'Unsent reply to Harbor' is not shown to be tied programmatically.
findings.after: <label for="draft-harbor">Unsent reply to Harbor</label><textarea id="draft-harbor">…</textarea> (or role="textbox" aria-multiline="true" aria-labelledby on the div)
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value and 1.3.1 Info and Relationships.
